extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is a large-scale open-source multimodal interleaved dataset comprising one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images across 1054M documents. It includes multimodal documents sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv papers, filtered for text quality, deduplicated, and screened for NSFW content and personally identifiable information.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.citeAs: Awadalla, A., Xue, L., Lo, O., Shu, M., Lee, H., Guha, E., Jordan, M., Shen, S., Awadalla, M., Savarese, S., Xiong, C., Xu, R., Choi, Y., & Schmidt, L. (2024). MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens. arXiv preprint arXiv:2406.11271v5.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was obtained by extracting and parsing interleaved multimodal documents from CommonCrawl WARC files (for HTML), CommonCrawl WAT files (for PDFs), and direct downloads from ArXiv S3 buckets (using LaTeX source code via TexSoup). Documents and images were then subjected to quality filtering, deduplication, and safety screening.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: None. The datasheet explicitly notes 'None' under missing information from individual instances, though external image URLs may be subject to link rot over time.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC dumps (May 2017 to April 2024), CommonCrawl WAT dumps (February 2023 to April 2024), and ArXiv source files from S3 buckets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: January 2024 to June 2024 (crawled/created data covers 2013 to 2024 / May 2017 to April 2024)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Documents were parsed using DOM trees for HTML, PyMuPDF for PDFs (extracting reading order and anchoring images), and TexSoup for ArXiv (cleaning LaTeX code, removing tables/citations/imports). Non-English text was filtered using Fasttext (threshold 0.65). Low-quality text was filtered using MassiveText rules and duplicate n-gram removal from RefinedWeb. Images were filtered based on URL substrings, size (150 to 20,000 pixels), and aspect ratio (<= 2 for HTML, <= 3 for PDFs). NSFW images were detected and removed using a deep neural network detector. PII (email addresses and IP addresses) was anonymized. Paragraph and document deduplication was performed using a Bloom Filter (13-grams, 0.01 false positive rate; documents with >80% duplicate paragraphs were removed). Common boilerplate sentences were removed via exact deduplication on 2% of each snapshot. Image deduplication removed images appearing >10 times per snapshot via SHA256 hashes.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: FastText (language identification), Gant Laborde deep NN for NSFW image detection (https://github.com/GantMan/nsfw_model), GPT-4 (used for domain topic classification during analysis)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained by the authors, who will actively respond to issues via email and the Huggingface Issues tab. Updates will be communicated through the README in the Huggingface interface, and an erratum will be maintained there. Older versions remain accessible via Git history. Contributions are accepted via Hugging Face Pull Requests. A Google Form is provided for individuals to request opt-out/removal of data.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Sourced from the public web, so images of individuals and text about specific individuals may be present, potentially including race, ethnic origins, sexual orientations, religious beliefs, political opinions, financial, health, or location data. Email addresses and IP addresses were explicitly anonymized/masked to mitigate personal data leakage.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Aims to advance open-source research and bridge the gap between closed-source and open-source large multimodal models by providing a 10x larger, diverse dataset. Considers risks of exposing harmful web content and addresses safety through PII masking and NSFW filtering, while noting future work should further explore web data safety.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Language bias towards English (non-English filtered out). Avoided model-based text quality filters to prevent demographic bias. Domain distributions vary by source: HTML shows balanced domain representation, while PDFs have a higher concentration of Science & Technology content.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Not self-contained: relies on external image URLs which are vulnerable to link rot. PyMuPDF parsing limitations: occasionally fails to detect images and sometimes extracts incorrect reading order across multi-column layouts. Sourced from the web, so confidential or offensive data may inadvertently remain.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training large multimodal models (LMMs), in-context learning evaluations, interleaved image-text sequence generation, and multimodal document retrieval systems. Should not be used for military applications or training models to ingest/generate personally identifying information (such as facial images and sensitive personal content).
